copy: **I study how organisations adopt and benefit from digital technology.** My work develops analytical models, evaluation frameworks and AI-enabled tools that support innovation, policy development and organisational improvement — especially for SMEs and public institutions. With a background in project management and management engineering, I lean on **operations research and optimisation** to improve performance and decision quality. **I am motivated by research that connects theory to practice.**
